decisions.subtitle: Tungsten, Epoxy and your first IV circuits
desc:
You've built new &6chemistry lines&r, manufactured advanced &balloys&r, and mastered the &aCleanroom&r. We hope you enjoyed the ride, because now things get even more complex, with powerful new machines and demanding processes ahead.

In the &5EV Chapter&r, your main objective will be to craft your very first &1IV&r Circuits and the &1IV&r Machine Hull.
{@pagebreak}

Along the way, several key challenges await you:

• Process &eTungsten&r and turn it into &6Tungstensteel&r, the main material of &1IV&r.

• Upgrade your EBF to &6RTM Coils&r, which open Tantalum Carbide and your first &6Alloy Blast Smelter&r.

• Set up &aEpoxy&r production for the boards of your &bNano&r Circuits.

Good luck, this is where GregTech begins to show its true depth!

TFG's soda-ash tungsten line isn't in this pack. GregTech's line verified: tungstic acid -> EV electrolyzer (960 EU/t) -> tungsten dust + hydrogen + oxygen; tungsten EBF 3,600 K, hot ingot. Dep moved from the dropped TFG step 2 to step 1.
decisions.subtitle: Heavy metal
desc:
Congrats on making your first &6Tungsten&r! Electrolyze &bTungstic Acid&r in an &5EV&r Electrolyzer for Tungsten dust, plus some Hydrogen and Oxygen back.

Tungsten ingots need an &3EBF&r at 3,600K (Nichrome coils will do) and come out hot.

Remember that the further you progress, the more important it will be to build dedicated and passive lines for all these complex processes that will be required until the end of the pack. Don't be afraid of lacking resources, be afraid of lacking time.

decisions.reason: Rewritten for GregTech's own tungsten line (verified: scheelite or tungstate dust + hydrochloric acid in an EV chemical bath, 960 EU/t -> tungstic acid + calcium/lithium chloride); TFG's 'reworked, much harder' line and Mars veins don't apply. DOUBT: scheelite and tungstate have no veins and no processing source in the pack, so tungsten is currently unobtainable.
decisions.title: The Tungsten Line
desc:
&eTungsten&r comes from &aScheelite&r or &aTungstate&r dust: bathe it in Hydrochloric Acid in an &5EV Chemical Bath&r to get &bTungstic Acid&r, with Calcium Chloride or Lithium Chloride on the side.

Neither mineral has its own veins in this pack.

Take your time, optimize, and the Tungsten Line will become the foundation of your mid-to-late game progress.

decisions.reason: AE2 isn't in the pack; the advice now says to automate crafting in general.
desc:
You know what to do with this by now, but this is a good time to give you a heads up that now is the time to scale up your factory if you haven't already done so.

Automate the crafting of new machines and components to keep your factory running at tip-top shape, because if you don't, the rest of EV is going to hit you like a brick wall.

Don't wait to find out the hard way!
{@pagebreak}

At the very least, here's what we recommend before pushing further into EV:

&9-&r Passive production of Rubber, Polyethylene, Oxygen, Hydrogen, Nitrogen, and Chlorine
&9-&r At least two general-purpose EBFs, and a few LCRs
&9-&r Automated production of a circuit of every tier and most of the common crafting components like motors, pumps, plates, and wires
&9-&r A dedicated ore processing setup
&9-&r A couple EV amps worth of power generation (see the below quests)

You can do it, you've made it this far already!

decisions.reason: Removed the AE2 routing suggestion. Epoxy chain verified (epichlorohydrin + bisphenol A + sodium hydroxide; bisphenol A from acetone + phenol + HCl; salt water byproduct).
desc:
&aEpoxy&r is the foundation for all future Circuit Boards in the game!

&9&lNote:&r This Quest is quite complicated, so tackle everything else before trying to make Epoxy. You'll need all the help you can get!
{@pagebreak}

There are several ways to obtain the ingredients for &aEpoxy&r.

We will ignore recipes related to Glycerol, as they're never worth it.

Try and use &3Large Chemical Reactors&r to shortcut recipes.
{@pagebreak}

&dChlorine&r is only partially recycled, so you'll need a constant supply. Feeding it manually will be sufficient at first.

Recipes involving &dSodium Hydroxide&r could be looped by electrolyzing the &9Salt Water&r co-product.

Doing this will probably require you to make some Quadruple Pipes, Pump Covers and Fluid Filters.

In general, closed loop setups are nice to prevent overproduction or overconsumption, but go for whatever's more fun for you.

decisions.reason: gtceu:oil_light/medium/heavy_bucket don't exist; this pack's oils are oil, light_oil, heavy_oil and raw_oil. Text rewritten with verified sources: heavy oil from logs in the pyrolyse oven, other oils from GregTech's bedrock fluid veins (not switched off here); the DT splits steam-cracked fuels into benzene, toluene, butene, butadiene; the cracker and desulfurizing step exist.
desc:
The &3Distillation Tower&r splits crude oils and cracked fuels into all their fractions at once.

You will want to set this up &lbefore&r moving to &1IV&r.

Heavy Oil comes from logs in the &3Pyrolyse Oven&r, the other oils from bedrock fluid veins. Distill them into sulfuric fuels, clean those with Hydrogen, steam-crack the Light Fuel or Naphtha and distill the result again for &aBenzene&r, &aToluene&r, &aButene&r and &aButadiene&r.

decisions.reason: Only the chapter pointer changes (TFG's Energy chapter -> this book's power chapter). The 25%% claim checked: e.g. tungstensteel 750 ticks/ingot vs 1,000 in the EBF, nichrome 975 vs 1,300; the ABS outputs molten metal and makes the GCYM alloys.
desc:
The &6Alloy Blast Smelter&r is a very special multiblock. It works similarly to the &6EBF&r, with better coils allowing for Perfect Overclocking (see the power chapter), and it can process most EBF alloys straight from their element dusts &a25%% faster&r. Note that it outputs molten fluids instead of hot ingots!

One key feature of the &6ABS&r is its ability to craft the alloys needed for &6Large Multiblock Machines&r. Essentially, every basic machine like the Macerator or the Distillery has its own multiblock, offering extensive customization options such as multiple Input/Output Buses/Hatches or even adding a Parallel Hatch.

decisions.reason: Removed TFG claims (harder tungsten, RTM for fission multiblocks). Verified: 4 ruthenium + 2 tungsten + 1 molybdenum in the EV mixer (1,920 EU/t), EBF 3,000 K. DOUBT: molybdenum has no source in the pack.
desc:
To craft &6RTM Alloy&r, you'll need &dRuthenium&r, a product of the infamous &dPlatline&r, &aTungsten&r and a little &aMolybdenum&r, mixed in your &5EV&r Mixer and smelted in the EBF at 3,000K.

Before rushing into RTM production, make sure your Platline and Tungsten line are running smoothly.

Its main use is the &6RTM Coil&r, a powerful upgrade for your EBF and many of your other coil multiblocks.

decisions.reason: Removed lunar regolith/Ostrum and TFG's fission gating of the IV Assembler. Verified: tantalum carbide blasts at 4,120 K; ABS needs tantalum carbide plates; coil = 8 RTM double wire + 8 vanadium steel foil + molten nichrome (EV assembler). Dep on TFG's nichromium iodomethylate (Mars) removed so it doesn't relink into the fission chain.
desc:
The &6RTM Coils&r can reach an impressive &e4,500K&r, unlocking access to &dTantalum Carbide&r (4,120K), a key material for your progression: you'll need it to craft the &5Alloy Blast Smelter&r. They will also greatly speed up the recipes in your EBF.

Each coil takes RTM wire, Vanadium Steel foil and molten Nichrome, so your Nichrome production pays off again.

decisions.reason: Removed the nuclear multiblock casing line. Verified: the ABS needs tantalum carbide plates; these alloys go into GCYM casings (high temperature smelting, non-conducting, corrosion proof, MoSi2 coils); TaC needs 4,120 K. DOUBT: HSLA steel and molybdenum disilicide need molybdenum, which has no source in the pack.
desc: Welcome to the world of &dLarge Multiblocks&r. These alloys build the casings of the large versions of GregTech's machines, starting with the &eAlloy Blast Smelter&r, which needs Tantalum Carbide plates. Tantalum Carbide needs the heat of your new RTM Coils.
{@pagebreak}

&o&6&lLore&r:&r &oGregicality Multiblocks originally began as a mod for GTCEu on Minecraft 1.12, adding the large versions of GregTech machines and the &6Parallel Hatch&r. &oWhen GTCEu was ported to 1.20, this mod was fully integrated into &dGTm&r - &osomething no one ever complained about&r. For the 1.12 enjoyers out there, you might remember them as the &dGCYM multis&r.

decisions.reason: Removed the Venus note; added the verified steps (PGS centrifuged with aqua regia -> inert metal mixture; + sulfuric acid in an EV chemical reactor, 1,920 EU/t -> ruthenium tetroxide; + carbon -> ruthenium). PGS here comes from TFC tetrahedrite (purified ore + nitric acid).
desc:
To help you along, here's an overview of the steps to &dRuthenium&r through the Platline: centrifuge &dPlatinum Group Sludge&r with Aqua Regia, react the &aInert Metal Mixture&r with Sulfuric Acid in an &5EV&r Chemical Reactor for &aRuthenium Tetroxide&r, then reduce it with Carbon.

Don't worry, you don't need to complete the entire &dPlatline&r yet.

desc:
The &dNano CPU Wafer&r is your gateway to Nano Circuits and your second kind of &1IV&r Circuit.

Coat a CPU Wafer with molten Glowstone and Raw Carbon Fibers (Carbon dust and Epoxy in an Autoclave) in an &5EV&r Chemical Reactor inside your Cleanroom, then cut it into chips in an &6HV&r Cutter.

You'll need a huge amount of these circuits, so automate the line early.

decisions.reason: Here the Microprocessor Mainframe doesn't need Nano CPUs (TFG gated it behind fission); it's made in the HV circuit assembler (480 EU/t, cleanroom). The EV circuit assembler takes two IV circuits. Removed Framed Moderate Core/refrigerant pellets (TFG fission).
desc:
Finally, after all this time, you've obtained a new circuit and unlocked an entirely new tier. Mainframes are made in the &6HV&r Circuit Assembler inside your Cleanroom.

Your main focus should be the &5EV Circuit Assembler&r, which takes two of them and unlocks &bNanoprocessor Circuits&r. Keep in mind, though, that these will require Nano CPU Chips.

More details will be provided as you go, so you can finally feel fully comfortable progressing into this new tier.

desc:
Your first &eNano Circuits&r! They need &bNano CPU Chips&r and the SMD components you've been making, all in the &5EV&r Circuit Assembler inside your Cleanroom.

At first, &eNano Circuits&r will feel quite expensive, but once your Nano CPU production is fully passive, they will turn into one of your cheapest ones!

desc:
Obtain &aPhenol&r from:

&91 -&r &aWood Tar&r distillation.

&92 -&r Reacting &aBenzene&r with &dChlorine&r and &dSodium Hydroxide&r This should be performed in an &3LCR&r, and the Chlorine is perfectly looped.

&93 -&r Shortcutting the above recipe by ignoring the &dSodium Hydroxide&r. This is net negative on &dChlorine&r.

&94 -&r Reacting &aBenzene&r, &dPropene&r and &dOxygen&r using a small amount of &4Phosphoric Acid&r - normally a catalyst, but consumed here in small quantities. This is called the Cumene process.
{@pagebreak}

If you're having trouble deciding between the options presented, here's the appeal of each route:

&91 -&r Great if you're willing to set up a &3Pyrolyse Oven&r + &3Distillation Tower&r combo.

&92 -&r This one's our preference! You can use the &dSalt&r to make more &dSalt Water&r, then electrolyze to create a loop.

&93 -&r Very appealing if you have an infinite supply of &dChlorine&r. You could achieve this by setting up a &3Fluid Drilling Rig&r on a Salt Water vein.

&94 -&r ...&4Phosphoric Acid&r is a pain to produce. You'd be mad to consider this.
